facts.fact: Rohan has stood the dawn watch at the Shilak Cairn for several mornings because Ila wrote from Garh Neshar that she would come out at Shilak if the mountain let her; she did not say how.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Rohan's wardens at the cairn at dawn when Kunal and Ila emerge.

facts.fact: Beyond the Under-Cairn door a stair of laid stones with blue seams climbs to a gap between two slabs inside the Shilak Cairn ring.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a meltwater crack exit under the Shilak Cairn.

facts.fact: Meera is now a pardoned licensed guide, with a licence cord and the queen's seal at her belt.
facts.why: needed because the beat describes her as pardoned and licensed at the door.

facts.fact: Pasang walks out bound to Raghu as a witness; Kunal offers to write his name under his testimony about where the route-keepers are held, without promising their release.
facts.why: needed to resolve Pasang's refusal while avoiding an unkeepable bound promise.
